Total CC = 5. ✓ matches CI (CC 5).

Now — for thread 5, the cleanest approach that matches existing patterns:

In `rebuildToolAvailability()`:
```dart
final resolution = resolveToolAvailability(capabilities: toolCapabilities(), ...);
``
Before this, refresh the cached live vision config:
```dart
// gh-1984 (review thread 5): the media capabilities and registrations
// follow the LIVE vision slot — refreshed once per rebuild so a
// mid-session `/models set` is reflected by the next /tools (or any
// availability pass) instead of contradicting the live auto-route.
_toolsWiring.resolvedVision = await _resolveVisionCapability();
_syncInspectImageTool(_toolsWiring.resolvedVision);
``

with
```dart
Future<InspectImageConfig?> _resolveVisionCapability() async {
 try {
  return await _readVisionResolver();
 } on Object {
  return null; // a failed slot read (broken store) reports absent — /tools says so.
 }
``

Hmm — should a resolver error hide the tool? The read auto-route degrade handles failures per read. For the capability, a failed resolution → treat as absent (honest /tools). Fine.

`toolCapabilities()`:
```dart
'inspect_image': _toolsWiring.resolvedVision != null
  ? on
  : const ToolCapability.absent('no vision model configured — set ...'),
``

Wait, but `toolCapabilities()` may be called BEFORE the first refresh (rebuildToolAvailability calls it after refresh — the only caller). Good.

But also `_syncInspectImageTool` — hmm, do I want the registration to follow? The reviewer's scenario: mid-session /models set vision → /tools says off + false advice; AC3 note names an unregistered tool. My fix: registration + capability both follow the live resolver on every rebuild. `/tools reload` then makes everything consistent. Also the missing piece — `/models set` itself should trigger a rebuild so the state flips immediately. In provider_models.dart `_setModelsSlot` (and `_removeModelsSlot`), after `config.onModelsConfigChanged?.call()`, add `unawaited(AgentCliTools(this).rebuildToolAvailability());`. That file is `part of agent_cli.dart`? Let me check. If yes, calling AgentCliTools(this).rebuildToolAvailability() is direct.

Let me also double-check `_toolsList` shows reason from resolution — after refresh+rebuild, reasons are accurate.

Also the SECOND bullet of thread 5: "with images.autoInspect: false, the omission note tells the agent 'call inspect_image' — a tool that is not registered in this session." With registration synced, when the vision slot resolves, inspect_image IS registered → the note is true. When the slot resolves to null, the AC4 note (no vision configured) shows instead. Consistent.

For test B, use the resolver closure toggling a bool, run /tools reload, assert the line flips.

`_agent.state.tools` is set once (`_agent.state.tools = _toolRegistry.tools` — an unmodifiable snapshot list, but the Tool OBJECTS inside are references). After the swap, the snapshot list still holds the OLD read tool instance! The gate `_toolGate.apply` might update state.tools... The integration test used `recorder.toolsOf(turn)` (the Context.tools of the NEXT model call). To be safe in my test, look up via `cli.agent` — hmm, is there a public registry accessor on AgentCli? The AC10 test grabbed read from `cli.agent.state.tools`. After the swap that instance is stale. Better to fetch the CURRENT instance each time via a fresh snapshot — the registry is private to the CLI though.

Alternative: get the read tool from the agent state AFTER the swap — the gate's apply() might re-assign state.tools. Let me check ToolAvailabilityGate.apply.

+/// The non-vision branch of [_readImageResult] (gh-1984): resolves the
+/// live vision capability, then either auto-routes the description
+/// (AC2), or builds the guidance note (AC3 autoInspect off / AC4 no
+/// vision model). Split from the dispatcher so the gate's complexity
+/// census stays per-stage (the CI CRAP ratchet measures per function).
+Future<ToolExecutionResult> _routeNonVisionImage(
+  String path,
+  _InlineImageResult processed, {
+  Future<InspectImageConfig?> Function()? vision,
+  bool Function()? autoInspect,
+  void Function(Usage usage)? onImageUsage,
+  CancelToken? cancelToken,
+}) async {
+  final visionConfig = await vision?.call();
+  if (visionConfig == null ||
+      !(autoInspect?.call() ?? imageRegistryConfig.autoInspect)) {
+    return _omittedImageResult(path, processed, extra: _nonVisionGuidance(
+      visionConfig,
+    ));
+  }
+  return _autoRouteVisionDescription(
+    path,
+    processed,
+    visionConfig,
+    onImageUsage: onImageUsage,
+    cancelToken: cancelToken,
+  );
+}
+
+/// The AC3/AC4 note: how the agent gets the image seen when the
+/// auto-route is not taking it — name the tool + the configured model
+/// (AC3), or the configure hint (AC4).
+String _nonVisionGuidance(InspectImageConfig? visionConfig) {
+  if (visionConfig != null) {
+    return '\n[A vision model is configured (${visionConfig.modelId}): call '
+        'inspect_image to describe this image.]';
+  }
+  return '\n[No vision model is configured — set one with /settings → Media '
+      'models → vision (models.slots.vision) or --vision-model <id> to '
+      'let the agent see images.]';
+}
+
+/// One vision-model call for the read (gh-1984 AC2): the budget gate, the
+/// inline description with the attribution marker, and the AC6 degrades.
+Future<ToolExecutionResult> _autoRouteVisionDescription(
+  String path,
+  _InlineImageResult processed,
+  InspectImageConfig visionConfig, {
+  void Function(Usage usage)? onImageUsage,
+  CancelToken? cancelToken,
+}) async {
+  // The images.maxBytesPerRequest budget (issue #1916) applies to the
+  // auto-route call too: base64 chars are wire bytes 1:1.
+  final budget = imageRegistryConfig.maxBytesPerRequest;
+  if (processed.base64.length > budget) {
+    return _omittedImageResult(
+      path,
+      processed,
+      extra:
+          '\n[Vision inspection skipped: the image exceeds '
+          'images.maxBytesPerRequest ($budget bytes).]',
+    );
+  }
+  try {
+    // The PROCESSED payload rides (gh-1984 review thread 1): the gate
+    // measured `processed.base64`, the mime names the converted/kept
+    // payload, and the request must carry exactly those bytes — a
+    // resized/converted original (the common photo/screenshot case)
+    // uploaded raw would bypass `images.maxBytesPerRequest` and ship
+    // bytes disagreeing with the declared mime.
+    final description = await describeImageWithVisionModel(
+      visionConfig,
+      base64Decode(processed.base64),
+      processed.mimeType,
+      '',
+      cancelToken: cancelToken,
+      onUsage: onImageUsage,
+    );
+    cancelToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    // The auto-route REPLACES the bare omission note (gh-1984 AC2): the
+    // image bytes are not attached, the vision model's description rides
+    // inline with the attribution marker.
+    return ToolExecutionResult(
+      content: [
+        TextContent(
+          text:
+              '${_imageNoteHeader(path, processed, null)}\n'
+              '[The image is not attached — the current model has no image '
+              'input.]\n'
+              '[via vision model ${visionConfig.modelId}]\n'
+              '$description',
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  } on CancelledException {
+    rethrow;
+  } on Object catch (error) {
+    // A cancel surfacing as a provider stream error must stay a cancel
+    // (AC6), not a degrade note.
+    cancelToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    // Degrade, never fail the read (AC6): the omission note names why.
+    return _omittedImageResult(
+      path,
+      processed,
+      extra:
+          '\n[Vision inspection via vision model '
+          '${visionConfig.modelId} failed: $error. The read continues '
+          'without the image.]',
+    );
+  }
+}

static:
    name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"

# gh-1738: activate is its own step so the Quality gates step below
      # can run for docs-only / app-zone-only PRs too — the similarity
      # corpus lives in docs/, prompts/, flutter_app/ and packages/, and
      # a diff confined there must reach the gate pre-merge (it routes
      # away from the CRAP ratchet, which needs the merged lcov).
      - name: Activate crap4dart (pinned)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: pin bumped 0.2.1 → >=0.9.5 for the gate framework.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          # crap4dart#3/#4 (2026-10-15): >=0.14.2 — the broken_goldens
          # detector fixes (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow
          # boxes, solid glyph runs); the configs now rely on 0.14.2
          # behaviour (severity: error, old excludes dropped).
          # gh-1738: >=0.15.0 — the similarity gate (file-level
          # near-duplicates over md+dart), wired into crap4dart.yaml.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.15.0 <0.16.0"

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # crap4dart activated (pinned) in the step above.
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        # gh-1738: + docs/app — the similarity gate scans the whole tree
        # (docs/, prompts/, flutter_app/, packages/ included); no project
        # pub get needed (global tool, config+file gates only).
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']
          except Exception:
              pct = 0.0
          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

      # Issue #487: cross-module duplication gate (issue body measured 20
      # files shipped as app↔core/fa_ui/browser_ext clones). Runs the SAME
      # stage the pre-commit hook runs — one marker, parity diffable. The
      # app leg matters: most cross-module clones are born on the app side
      # and the CRAP/dup steps above stay core/shared-scoped.
      - name: Cross-module duplication ratchet (issue #487)

arguments.content:
# gh-1984 rework — review threads addressed (8/8), CI CRAP gate fixed

## Issues/Notes

- **CI guards red (owned)**: `crap4dart analyze` failed on
  `AgentCliTools._swapReadSqliteVariant CRAP 25 > 12` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart:425`)
  and the follow-on coverage-merge legs in the same job. The `static`/`analyze` legs were green.
  - **fixed**: `_swapReadSqliteVariant` split into `_swapReadSqliteVariant` (dispatcher: wantSqlite?,
    same-variant?, swap) + `_freshReadTool()` (the rebuilt `read` tool params). Verified with the
    CI-identical pipeline (`dart test --coverage` on the shard files that exercise it →
    `coverage:format_coverage --lcov` → `crap4dart analyze` 0.15.0, threshold 12):
    `_swapReadSqliteVariant` **CRAP 5.01** (94% cov), `_readImageResult` **6.02** (92%),
    `inspectImageTool` 3.0, `_syncInspectImageTool` 3.0, `cliVisionSlotResolver` 2.0 — all ≤ 12.
    No `// crap:ignore` needed, no baseline bump.
- **Local full-suite run**: 1 unrelated flake — `test/providers/stale_keepalive_repro_test.dart`
  scenario C (loopback socket RST race, provider keep-alive pool; a file this PR does not touch).
  Passes on immediate re-run (11/11). All other tests green (see Test Coverage).
- `.dmtools-target-workingdir` was swept into the branch by WIP auto-saves (thread 4): untracked via
  `git rm --cached`, deleted from the tree; `.gitignore:169-171` already ignores it, so it cannot
  return. Foreign/infra reds: none observed beyond that flake.

## Approach

Every open review thread got a code fix, driven RED→GREEN (repro test first, then the minimum fix),
on top of the existing PR branch:

1. **Thread 1 (BLOCKING, budget bypass)** — the read auto-route measured the processed payload but
   uploaded the raw file bytes. `_autoRouteVisionDescription` now sends
   `base64Decode(processed.base64)` + `processed.mimeType` (the exact gated payload), keeping the
   hard `images.maxBytesPerRequest` re-check before the call.
2. **Thread 2 (BLOCKING, empty main key)** — production wiring now builds the slot resolvers via the
   shared `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscribeSlotResolver` builders (`media_slot_configs.dart`)
   which receive the live `ModelsConfig`'s `mainBaseUrl`/`mainApiKey` and hand them to
   `resolveMediaSlotKey`; cross-host `/models set vision|transcription <id>` pins resolve the main
   connection key again.
3. **Thread 3 (BLOCKING, /cost regression)** — the sqlite `read` swap now passes the live
   `_readOnImageUsage` getter (resolves `config.onImageInspectUsage ?? _usage.addSideCall` at call
   time) instead of a construction-time sink, so auto-route spend stays in `/cost` after a swap.
4. **Thread 4 (BLOCKING, stray file)** — `.dmtools-target-workingdir` removed from the PR (above).
5. **Thread 5 (IMPORTANT, boot-static capabilities)** — `_syncInspectImageTool(resolvedVision)`
   registers/unregisters `inspect_image` on every availability rebuild and `transcribe_audio`
   availability reads a live slot knob; `/models set` mid-session now flips all three media
   surfaces together.
6. **Thread 6 (IMPORTANT, saved.models divergence)** — one live `ModelsConfig` instance
   (`saved.models ?? ModelsConfig()`) is shared by `AgentCliConfig.modelsConfig` (what `/models set`
   mutates) and the per-read resolvers (what they read); the divergence window is gone.
7. **Thread 7 (SUGGESTION)** — `inspect_image` takes `cancelToken`/`onUsage` via its services and
   calls `describeImageWithVisionModel` directly; the pass-through wrapper is gone; the host wiring
   supplies both (same source as the read auto-route).
8. **Thread 8 (SUGGESTION)** — `autoInspect` documented as a test seam (production reads the
   boot-published `imageRegistryConfig.autoInspect` global) on `readFileTool` and
   `_routeNonVisionImage`.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/tools/builtin_tools_read.dart` — auto-route sends the gated processed payload;
  `_routeNonVisionImage`/`_autoRouteVisionDescription` split (CRAP); seam doc.
- `lib/src/tools/inspect_image.dart` — services carry `cancelToken`/`onUsage`; wrapper dropped.
- `lib/src/tools/media_slot_configs.dart` — `cliVisionSlotResolver`/`cliTranscribeSlotResolver`
  builders with main-connection key reuse + live `ModelsConfig` sharing.
- `lib/src/tools/builtin_tools.dart` — `autoInspect` seam doc.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` — `_syncInspectImageTool` live capability sync;
  `_swapReadSqliteVariant` CRAP restructure with live `/cost` sink.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart` — shared live `ModelsConfig`
  instance wiring; live media-slot resolution.
- `lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, `lib/src/hosts/host_wiring_builder.dart` — host wiring
  passes cancel/usage services; doc drift fix.
- `bin/fah.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — CLI/app host builders share the live models instance.
- Tests: `test/tools/builtin_tools_test.dart`, `test/tools/inspect_image_test.dart`,
  `test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart`, `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — new regression tests
  for every thread (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7) including the boundary/edge cases the findings called out
  (BMP→PNG conversion pair, over-budget refusal, cross-host key fallback, own-key precedence,
  post-swap /cost, mid-session slot flips both directions, null→pinned live sync, cancelled token).
- `.dmtools-target-workingdir` — removed from git tracking (deletion staged in this push).

## Test Coverage

- RED→GREEN per finding; new tests listed per thread in `outputs/review_replies/*.md`.
- Targeted suites green: `builtin_tools_test.dart` (107), `inspect_image_test.dart` (8),
  `media_slot_configs_test.dart` (16), `agent_cli_test.dart` (89), `usage_summary_test.dart`
  (combined 226 green), plus `stale_keepalive_repro_test.dart` re-run after its unrelated flake (11).
- Full sharded unit suite (CI shard files, all 4 shards) run locally; 1 unrelated flake noted above.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files: no issues. `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` on all
  touched files: clean.
- CRAP gate verified with the CI-identical pipeline (subset coverage ⇒ CI's merged 4-shard lcov can
  only lower the scores): all changed-file functions ≤ 12; `_swapReadSqliteVariant` 25 → 5.01.

BLOCKING thread 1 — auto-route gates the resized payload but uploads the original bytes.

**Fixed.** The vision request is now built from the exact payload the budget gate measured:

- `lib/src/tools/builtin_tools_read.dart` — `_autoRouteVisionDescription` now sends `base64Decode(processed.base64)` with `processed.mimeType` to `describeImageWithVisionModel` instead of the raw file `bytes`. - The hard gate remains before the call (`processed.base64.length > budget` → omission note, no vision call), so the gate and the wire bytes are the same quantity by construction.

- `images.maxBytesPerRequest budget applies to the auto-route` — over-budget payload produces the skip note and no vision side-call.

BLOCKING thread 2 — resolvers never receive the main connection's key; the flagship `/models set vision|transcription <id>` flow resolves an EMPTY API key.

**Fixed.** The production wiring now builds the slot resolvers through the shared builders in `lib/src/tools/media_slot_configs.dart` (`cliVisionSlotResolver` / `cliTranscriptionSlotResolver`), which take the live `ModelsConfig` plus `mainBaseUrl`/`mainApiKey` and hand them to `resolveVisionSlotInspectConfig` / `resolveTranscriptionSlotConfig` → `resolveMediaSlotKey` — restoring the gh-184 same-host key reuse:

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — `resolveVisionConfig()` / `resolveTranscribeConfig()` are built by those builders with the main connection resolved from the live `ModelsConfig`, so the flagship flow (a same-host slot pin with no `apiKeyName`) authenticates with the main connection's key instead of an empty one.
- Key precedence per gh-184: a slot WITH its own `apiKeyName` resolves via that env key first; a same-host slot without one reuses the main key; a cross-host slot without its own key still resolves empty (no main-key leak to another host — the pre-existing rule, unchanged).

Tests (`test/tools/media_slot_configs_test.dart`):
- `flagless: a same-host slot with no apiKeyName reuses the MAIN key (review thread 2 — one rule with generate_image/generate_video)` — asserts the config handed to `inspectImageTool` carries the main key, exactly the slot shape `/models set vision <id>` writes.
- `flagless: a cross-host slot without apiKeyName resolves empty` — the by-design negative case.
- `flagless: the slot serves live and the same-host main-key rule applies` — the transcription twin.

2227 AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

content.text:
share ONE keep-alive `http.Client` (`sharedProviderHttpClient`) instead of
  a fresh client per call: per-turn TCP churn piled TIME_WAIT sockets into
  connect stalls. Config:
  `roles:`/`modelOverrides:`/`retry:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (invalid
  schema = `ConfigException`). Also the shared models config:
  `media_model_slots.dart` (media slot names/fields shared with the app's
  `MediaModelsStore` + strict yaml slot entry) and `models_config.dart`
  (the `models:` section — per-slot media overrides + named custom model
  definitions `/model <name>` resolves; mutable like the custom-provider
  registry, persisted by the host). Owner context override (issues
  #273/#729): `agent:`/`contextWindowCap` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` (strict
  section, minimum 16384 = the compaction reserve) SETS the EFFECTIVE
  context window via `effectiveContextWindow` (model.dart) for the
  compaction thresholds, the CLI ctx meter/footer and the loop's over-window
  guard — clamped down below the catalog window; raised above it to the
  served truth (a custom provider whose catalog entry under-reports, e.g. a
  to the same entry keeps its model).
  Saved-entry lookups are by base URL (`_entryForBaseUrl`), so a renamed
  entry is not duplicated on re-connect. Catalog switches RESET
  `_activeCustomName` (kimi/openrouter stored-key branches included) —
  a leaked marker made `/model` rewrite the previous custom entry's
  model memory. `/models` also manages
  the `models:` section: `/models config`/`set <slot> <model> [baseUrl]`/
  `remove <slot>` for media slot overrides (persisted via
  `onModelsConfigChanged`), and `/model <name>` resolves `models.custom`
  definitions. Keys: env first, then
  secure store (`lib/src/secrets/secure_key_store*.dart` — Keychain /
  Secret Service / PasswordVault, IO backends only in `lib/io.dart`),
  preloaded into `SecureKeyCache`. Resolution: the spec's DEFAULT endpoint
